basis: Star Group’s August 6 earnings release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found for fiscal Q3, the three months ended June 30, 2025. Its consolidated statement of operations reports total sales of $305,618,000 versus $331,640,000 a year earlier. The 95% threshold was $315,058,000, so reported sales were $9,440,000 below it. Both figures include product sales and installations and services on the reported consolidated basis, including acquired operations in the periods Star owned them.

coverage.detail: February 5 fiscal Q1 release. The 7.6% revenue decline applied to the December 2024 quarter. Star gave no numeric June-quarter sales outlook.

February 6 management call. The CFO attributed lower sales to lower product costs and said the effect would have to be assessed at the end of the heating season. Management gave no June-quarter revenue figure or range.
May 7 fiscal Q2 release. March-quarter revenue rose 11.6% to $743.0 million. Management discussed acquisitions, operating efficiency and HVAC expansion without quantifying June-quarter total sales.

May 8 management call, including Q&A. The CEO’s 3%–15% range described price increases on HVAC parts and equipment. Management gave no consolidated Q3 revenue forecast and said it would report Q3 results in August.
Star’s events archive confirms the February 6 and May 8 calls. Its next listed event was the August 7 Q3 results call. No intervening investor presentation appears in the archive.
The June 2 Form 8-K disclosed Star’s purchase of 0.7 million of its own common units for approximately $8.4 million. It contained no operating update.
Star’s 10-Q confirms that the July 17 announcement concerned a Q3 distribution of $0.1850 per common unit. The distribution supplied no sales figure.
Star’s July 31 notice scheduled the results release for after the August 6 close and the call for August 7. It gave no preliminary sales or guidance.
Star’s August 6 release identifies the June quarter as fiscal Q3 and reports a 7.8% year-over-year revenue decline. The accompanying table gives the precise quarterly amounts used above.

publication_date_evidence: Star’s investor-relations copy and SEC Exhibit 99.1 both carry an August 6, 2025 dateline and announce the June-quarter results that day. The July 31 issuer notice independently identifies August 6 as the scheduled release date.
